title: Patient Accounting Standard: Amount of an Add-On Charge on a Patient Payment Plans Plan
content:
This standard identifies the charge added to an active Patient Payment Plans plan as an add-on for an encounter the plan enrolled at its proposal, and fixes the amount at which it is added.

**1. Charge added.** The encounter is the one whose charge the plan most recently enrolled at its proposal. The charge added is the most recently posted charge of that encounter on the Patient Financial Account.

**2. Amount added.**

- The *remaining balance* of the charge is the charge amount less every time-of-service collection, payment and adjustment the financial account shows applied to it, never below 0.00.
- The *counted amount* is the remaining balance.
- The add-on amount is the counted amount, rounded half up to the cent, once, at the end.

**3. Records read.** The plan's initial enrollment entries (to identify the encounter), the charges on the financial account posted to that encounter, and the collections, payments and adjustments applied to the charge added.

### Worked figure (hypothetical)

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Charge amount | 900.00 |
| Time-of-service collection applied | 50.00 |
| Payments applied | 150.00 |
| Adjustments applied | 12.35 |
| Remaining balance | 687.65 |
| Counted amount | 687.65 |
| Add-on amount | 687.65 |

A charge of 200.00 against which 230.00 has been applied has a remaining balance of 0.00, never below it.

### Identifying the charge (hypothetical)

A plan enrolled, at its proposal, a charge of encounter E-1 on 2 February and a charge of encounter E-2 on 9 February. The encounter is E-2, whose charge was enrolled most recently. If the financial account later posts two further charges to E-2, on 1 April and on 15 April, the charge added is the one posted on 15 April.
